Job Description Summary:

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in IBM IMS™ Transaction Manager (TM) and Database (DB) application programming to drive the evolution of our IMS compatible technologies within our Enterprise modernization platform. This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building, maintaining, or optimizing IMS based applications on the mainframe and now wants to bring that domain knowledge into next generation tooling, runtimes, and replatforming solutions.
As a senior software engineer, you will provide architectural leadership, guide design of IMS compatible features, and translate complex mainframe concepts into a robust, performant implementation for distributed and cloud-based environments.

This role sits at the heart of our mission to modernize long-established, mission‑critical enterprise applications and to deliver stable, high-performance infrastructure relied on by global enterprises.

Architect & Build IMS TM/DB-Compatible Technologies

  • Contribute to the design and development of key components that replicate or extend IMS TM and DB behaviors—including message handling, transaction scheduling, PSB/DBD structures, DL/I call compatibility, and hierarchical database semantics.
  • Define and evolve architectural direction for our IMS replatforming runtime, ensuring parity with core IMS concepts where required and embracing modernization opportunities where beneficial.
  • Translate IMS internals and application programming patterns into scalable, reliable components on distributed systems.

Apply Deep IMS Domain Expertise

  • Model real-world IMS application scenarios (batch and online) within our modernization stack.
  • Provide authoritative guidance on IMS constructs such as:
    • Message queues, scheduling, and transaction regions
    • DBD/PSB design and access paths
    • DL/I call flows, PCB handling, segment structure, and hierarchical locking
    • IMS batch processing interactions with TM and DB
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to ensure features meet enterprise-grade reliability and performance expectations.

Technical Leadership

  • Contribute to cross-team engineering initiatives that impact compilers, runtimes, integration layers, and interoperability features.
  • Mentor engineers across teams, helping them understand IMS fundamentals and how those concepts should surface in our implementation.
  • Conduct deep technical reviews, troubleshoot complex runtime compatibility issues, and guide performance tuning strategies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Influence product roadmap decisions related to IMS replatforming, compatibility, and modernization.
  • Engage with customers, field engineering, and support teams to understand real‑world IMS workloads and migration scenarios.

What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering, including senior‑level ownership of complex system-level components.
  • Direct hands-on experience developing or maintaining IMS TM and DB applications on IBM z/OS (essential).
  • Deep knowledge of:
    • IMS message-driven architecture
    • Program specification blocks (PSBs), program communication blocks (PCBs), and DBD structures
    • DL/I calls and hierarchical database access
    • IMS transaction scheduling and message queue behavior
  • Strong proficiency in C, C++, or similar systems languages.
  • Experience delivering high-availability, mission-critical software systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background implementing or working with IMS exit routines, user exits, scheduling exits, or database utilities.
  • Experience with mainframe modernization, replatforming, or emulation technologies.
  • Familiarity with COBOL or PL/I application semantics and interactions with IMS environments.
  • Exposure to modern distributed systems, cloud-native design, or hybrid runtime architectures (Azure, AWS, Kubernetes).
  • Experience building compilers, runtimes, interpreters, or compatibility layers for legacy workloads.

Who You Are

  • An experienced engineer with strong domain knowledge IMS application behavior and system fundamentals.
  • Skilled at distilling mainframe concepts into modern software architecture.
  • Motivated by the challenge of modernizing long-standing, mission-critical platforms.
  • A mentor who raises the technical capabilities of the entire engineering organization.

Why Join Us?

  • Influence the design and implementation of next-generation IMS TM/DB modernization technology.
  • Work with a highly experienced engineering team deeply engaged in large-scale, mission-critical enterprise systems.
  • Play a foundational role in how customers migrate decades of IMS investments to flexible, modern environments.
  • A culture that values technical depth, long-term thinking, and system-level mastery.

Job Description:

DXC Technology is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates.

DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) helps insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions. A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets. You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Application\Middleware Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess a bachelor's degree in engineering with a minimum of ten years of relevant work experience. The candidate should demonstrate proficiency in middleware technologies with a focus on: AWS Technologies, Linux, Windows, IBM WebSphere, Apache Tomcat, Java, JBoss, SFTP, Dynatrace, IIS, Basic Server Administration, with an emphasis on providing Production Support and attention to detail.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.

  • Minimum ten years working in a global environment supporting over 270 clients with various technologies.

  • AWS Certifications or equivalent experience working within AWS

  • Proficiency in middleware technologies including IBM WebSphere, Apache Tomcat, Java, JBoss, SFTP, FTP, Dynatrace, IIS, Basic Server Administration

  • Senior Level Hands-on experience with Windows and Linux server administration.

  • Proficient in AWS services, S3 buckets, EKS clusters, ECS clusters, containers, Kubernetes, and terraform scripting.

  • PowerShell scripting and/or Python a plus

  • Basic knowledge of ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Sharepoint

  • Rotational Oncall Required to cover 24/7/365

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to talk to external clients and respond to incidents and compile RCAs.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and have a quick learner mindset.

  • Ability to do indepth analysis within the app\middleware products detecting issues, reviewing server performance and provide recommendations.

  • Experience with Dynatrace a plus and focus on details.

  • Ability to review server event logs, middleware SW logs, and Linux logs.

  • Understanding of Linux and Microsoft Active Directory security and basic security concepts and best practices.

Responsibilities:

  • Installation, configuration, deployment, and maintenance of applications hosted on various middleware platforms such as IBM Microfocus Cobol, CICS, IBM WebSphere, Apache Tomcat, Java, JBoss, IBM Cognos, IIS, AWS containers, NDM, AWS Connect, LDAP and Kubernetes.

  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues related to middleware technologies using Dynatrace alerts\logs, IBM logs, Linux logs and Windows logs.

  • Indepth analysis of performance using native Linux and Windows logs, and Dynatrace or Cloud Watch

  • Monitoring application and infrastructure alerts from Dynatrace and Cloud Watch

  • Basic knowledge of ITL Process as it pertains to IT systems\support\ Incident\Change\Problem Management.

  • Indepth knowledge of Incident, Problem and Change processes within ServiceNow.

  • Ability to Create Root Cause Analysis of any P1 or P2 incident. Understand the value and practice.

  • Ability to work independently and as a team.

  • Willingness to take ownership and accountability for issues and work for permanent resolutions using best IT practices and principles.

  • Ability to guide\train and document processes that are repeatable by the team. Provide Senior Level guidance to ensure service levels are met.

  • Ability to identify gaps in knowledge and create a process to fill those gaps.

  • Team player

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across the globe to ensure seamless delivery.

  • Addressing security vulnerabilities, creating an execution plan and working with various application\development teams to ensure critical events are addressed timely and plans are in place for quarterly review\execution.

Work Environment:

  • Core hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET

  • On-call support may be required; coverage operates on a 24/7/365 basis

Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over ~23000 professionals in >160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.

For additional information about Solenis, please visitwww.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

As Strategic Product and Market Manager you will partner across Product SBUs, Finance, Sales, Technology and Marketing to drive alignment and translate data into actionable strategies that drive growth, improve price realization, mix, and product line profitability. You serve as a strategic bridge between portfolio leadership and execution teams—enabling fact-based decision-making at the portfolio and sector level to drive margin improvement. While playing a critical role in increasing the share of differentiated, higher-margin products through disciplined pricing, cost management, supply strategy, and strong cross-functional coordination. You will bring advanced strategic marketing capabilities and analytical rigor to the team, helping to drive margin expansion through mix improvement and improved asset utilization working closely with Operations and Sales teams to drive strategic growth initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the North American Institutional Solutions product and market strategy to outperform competitors in our target market, driving profitable growth and achieving full margin potential.
  • Provide Strategic Business Unit (SBU) leadership and strategy development within North America to drive alignment across functions to activate strategic initiatives.
  • Own the NPI growth plan to improve portfolio competitiveness in alignment with Product Managers, Sector Marketing, Global Marketing and Technology teams.
  • Drive margin improvement through product mix optimization, disciplined pricing execution, cost management, and regional supply strategy.
  • Facilitate strategy and profitability improvement workshops
  • Collaborating with product managers, sales and operations to ensure the right products are made at the right assets to drive improved plant absorption
  • Support pricing analysis and strategy in collaboration with Product Managers and Pricing team.
  • Partner with sales on key deals and proposal development to improve win rates.
  • Provide regional guidance and input to Sector Marketing, Sales and Global Teams with high visibility to senior management.
  • Play a strong role in improving overall portfolio positioning to align with sector needs and expanding the share of differentiated, higher-margin products.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement, supporting an environment where individuals feel empowered to contribute and grow.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technical field. MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in the product lines / markets for which you would be responsible; exposure to pricing processes is required
  • Strong profitability and growth orientation; willingness to challenge the sales team when required; and the mindset to work through details
  • Strategic thinker and problem solver with the ability to apply analytical solutions to business problems
  • Strong background in strategic marketing and pricing fundamentals with demonstrated application of key frameworks to develop winning strategies
  • Strong time management and cross-functional people management skills
  • Ability to facilitate and lead cross functional workshops to solve complex problems
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, presentation, and leadership skills, with the ability to motivate team members
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with and influence multiple teams
  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English
  • Industry and customer literacy, or the ability to quickly learn Solenis/Diversey markets and technologies
  • Strong financial acumen to support systems and interface effectively with sales and marketing organizations to drive specific action plans and programs
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI tools to solve business problems—not just theoretical knowledge
  • Experience translating ambiguous, fragmented, or low-quality data environments into actionable insights
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Data structures, APIs, and data flows
    • Analytics / BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Excel advanced modeling)
    • Prompt engineering and AI-assisted workflows (content, analysis, automation)
  • Proven ability to turn data into decisions (pricing, portfolio optimization, customer segmentation)

Ideally we would like someone located within travel distance of Fort Mill, SC. However for the right candidate we would be open to someone remote who can travel.

We understand that candidates will not meet every single desired qualification. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about you.

At Solenis, we understand that our greatest asset is our people. That is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits which include medical, dental, vision & 401K, and numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. So, if you are interested in working for a world-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, whether in the lab or the field, consider joining our team.

raw.title: Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships
raw.excerpt: Overview of Watson Institute:Watson Institute powers transformative Fellowships in partnership with leading corporations and foundations to support highly promising entrepreneurs and leaders from underserved backgrounds.
raw.description:
Overview of Watson Institute:

Watson Institute powers transformative Fellowships in partnership with leading corporations and foundations to support highly promising entrepreneurs and leaders from underserved backgrounds. The Fellowships provide proven entrepreneurship and leadership skills training, committed mentorship, community development stipends, long-term Alumni support, and access to a global community of peers, mentors, and opportunities.

In partnership with Google, JPMorganChase Foundation, Walmart.org, Wells Fargo, Ford Philanthropy, SAP, Truist Foundation, BMO, Comcast, Western Union, and several private foundations, Watson Institute’s programs will reach over 2,400 rising leaders this year.

Alumni of Watson Institute’s Fellowships have raised over $190 million, created over 2,300 paid jobs, and impacted over 11 million people around the world through initiatives they have helped lead. 93% of Watson Institute alums are employed, continuing their education, or building a venture. 85% of Watson Institute Alumni use a skill they learned while in a Watson Institute-powered program up to 12 years later. Watson Institute’s Alumni have been selected to Y Combinator, the Echoing Green Fellowship, and 11 have been named to Forbes’ 30 under 30 lists. Alums continue their education at Harvard University, New York University, and Princeton University, among others.

Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships - Mission Statement:

The primary mission of the Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships is to build and grow a portfolio of Watson Institute’s corporate and foundation partnerships.

Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships – Role:

Partnership Building - 80%:

Play a critical role in building and growing a portfolio of partnerships with corporations and foundations to create Fellowships powered by Watson Institute.

  • Write and design compelling, persuasive, tailored, and well-designed/visual impact updates for Watson Institute’s top prospects and partners. These impact updates may include decks, emails, Alumni and Fellow highlights, Fellow profiles, and more.
  • Participate and lead prospect and partner meetings including associated preparation, talking points during the meeting, diligent notes, timely and comprehensive follow-ups, and coordination with appropriate team members on action items.
  • Complex Stakeholder Mapping and Engagement: Coordinate and strategically engage a complex map of stakeholders across each corporate and foundation partner.
  • Develop compelling concept notes, decks, and grant applications for prospects and partners. These concept notes, decks, and grant applications should demonstrate both business impact (for the partner) and community impact (for the Fellows and their communities) in a strategic and nuanced way.
  • Design impactful points of ‘business connectivity’ that create connections across multiple teams and business goals within each corporate/foundation prospect and partner. Points of business connectivity include: Alignment with corporate strategy, impact and business goals; employee engagement; compelling communications content; brand amplification; supply chain connections; among others to deepen the impact of the Fellowship.
  • Coordinate with Watson Institute’s VP of Strategic Partnerships, CEO, and other members of the leadership team closely to ensure successful outcomes across all partnerships.
  • Collaborate with Watson Institute’s Design Team on the monitoring, evaluation, and learning process and analysis to ensure impact metrics support partner expectations.

Special Projects - 20%:

Serve as the Strategic Partnerships Lead for special projects that are critical to Watson Institute’s corporate partnership strategy and growth. Examples include conducting a landscape analysis for partners who are looking to bring their Fellowship to new markets and developing thought pieces/reports on current trends in corporate impact and community impact.

*New responsibilities may develop as the position evolves.

Requirements

Culture Add:

In order to thrive as the Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships at Watson Institute, a candidate must:

  • Eager to join a team with extremely high standards for quality and excellence, recognizing that demonstrating excellence in partnership building is a direct path to scaling impact and achieving outsized results.
  • An exceptional eye for detail. You enjoy spending time in the details with words, style, formatting, and talking points in order to make the most compelling product possible.
  • Detail Oriented: You are meticulous and have excellent organizational skills. You are especially attuned to spotting mistakes or inconsistencies in writing and external communications. You take pride in completing your work accurately and on schedule. You have a knack for project management and a love for work plans and checklists. You cringe at missed steps and you are the first to identify a typo or formatting error.
  • Intentional: Your working style is about creating order and planning ahead. You think systematically and excel at establishing elegant processes.
  • Results-Driven: You bring an eagerness to grow and to roll up your sleeves and contribute. You have a go-getter attitude and a drive to solve all sorts of problems, no matter the size or shape. When you take on a responsibility, you find a way to see it through to the end.
  • High Integrity: You will be asked to make sensitive and critical judgment calls, and as such, you are known for your integrity and you take that reputation seriously. You always choose to make the right decision versus the easy decision. You know what information is sensitive, and you will protect it accordingly. You are comfortable escalating issues and holding your ground when you think it’s the right thing to do for the organization and mission.
  • Systems-minded: Demonstrated experience in building and implementing systems. You are comfortable designing, testing, improving, and smoothly running systems and processes. This could be any system that involves inputs from or serves multiple people and requires consistent and accurate functioning.
  • Communication Style: Based on a story from Watson Institute’s early days, ‘Come to the Window’ represents the principles of our communication including:
  • Obligation to Dissent: If you disagree with a decision or direction as an organization, you are expected to bring attention to this challenge because true leaders believe dissent is an obligation.
  • Disagree and Commit: To complement Obligation to Dissent, there are times when we need to Disagree and Commit. Once all concerns and criticisms are shared, the course of action must be committed to by all involved.
  • No Drama: We prioritize purpose and don’t involve ourselves in the drama created by backroom chatter, hearsay, and unnecessary focus on issues that do not place impact first.
  • Go to the Source: Our culture is defined by direct, honest, and frequent communication. We expect team members to ‘go to the source’ of concerns by speaking up, communicating frequently, and taking issues directly to the individuals involved.

Candidate Profile:

Top candidates should demonstrate:

  • A deep-seated passion for Watson Institute’s mission to develop innovators, leaders, and entrepreneurs to solve the toughest challenges facing the world.
  • Experience in enterprise sales/strategic partnership roles, specifically with corporations, corporate foundations, and corporate CSR teams. Previous experience should include building and growing impactful corporate partnerships that deliver on business impact (for the corporate partner) and community impact (for the Fellows and their communities).
  • A natural inclination to build and strengthen relationships and partnerships to grow Watson Institute’s impact.
  • A love and talent for persuasive writing, complex enterprise sales, and communication designed to build and grow impactful corporate and foundation partnerships.
  • A systems-oriented and highly organized approach to work.
  • Experience with Salesforce (or other CRM platforms) and Canva (or other graphic design platforms) are a strong plus.
  • Mandatory skills: Excel mastery, email wizardry, rapid follow-up, and data analysis.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary according to experience: $80,000.00-$95,000.00.
  • Annual Happiness Fund that increases with time and seniority.
  • Unlimited vacations (3 weeks required vacation time per year).
  • Healthcare benefit via Thatch (ICHRA provider), where employees have the option to apply this amount towards their choice of medical plans, with the option to add vision and dental plans.
  • Automatic 3% contribution to your retirement account.

The Vitals:

  • The Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships is a full-time commitment and reports to the VP of Strategic Partnerships.
  • The Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships position can work remotely, but should be based in CO, PA, GA, FL, ME, AZ, DC, OK, SC, IL, or MD.
  • Travel: You will likely take short trips each year to spend immersive, hands-on time with our team, Fellows, and partners—whether at events, conferences, or other programming.
  • We accept applications on a rolling basis until the position is filled.
  • The start date for this position is July 13, 2026 or sooner.
  • We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

The Client Executive is responsible for providing support to the AVMA Program Executive and the AVMA Relationship Manager for AVMA Trust; responsible for growing satisfied client relationships, maintaining a profitable book of business, and implementing and integrating new and expanded products into the clients’ portfolios. The Client Executive leads communication between AVMA Trust and the service team members, including administration, sales, customer service, marketing, database management, IT, etc. for all product lines offered by AVMA Insurance Services.

Your Impact:

  • Sustain and grow revenue by providing support to the Program Executive and Relationship Manager
  • Manage and assume responsibility for customer satisfaction for assigned client(s).
  • Prepare reports and presentations for client meetings, stewardships, and governing committee meetings; follow up with meeting notes and ensure action items are completed.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and generate meaningful reports
  • Collaborate with Pearl Marketing Group (PMG) and business leaders to ensure marketing strategies and campaigns for all AVMA Insurance Services product lines are implemented and meet client expectations, deliverables, and profitability goals.
  • Coordinate regular marketing strategy meetings with PMG and client to include cross-sell and upsell strategies across all product lines, annual marketing plan and calendar reviews, annual budget tracking to ensure costs are not exceeded, and serve as a conference/event liaison for the client and Pearl’s event’s coordinator to ensure client expectations are met.
  • Work with the Reporting and the Data Teams to prepare monthly and annual client reports, board reports, and other ad hoc reporting as requested by client and the AVMA Trust client services team.
  • Work with internal departments to monitor service levels to ensure they meet or exceed client expectations.
  • Review processes and procedures; proactively make changes to ensure efficiency and the best possible customer experience.
  • Communicate and coordinate activities with AVMA Trust, carriers, vendors on changes, updates, and/or issues that relate to administration, marketing, sales, and customer service for AVMA Insurance Services.
  • Develop annual T&E budget for client activities.
  • Support the AVMA Trust client services team with other duties as needed.

Successful Candidates Will Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business management, marketing, or related field.
  • 5+ years of industry related experience in client management, sales, and/or administration; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to interface effectively at all levels within an organization.
  • Life and Health, Accident, Personal Lines, Property and Casualty insurance licenses.

One80 Intermediaries is part of Arrowhead Intermediaries, a global insurance distribution platform that offers deep specialization, scale, and innovation across wholesale brokerage, program administration, and specialty insurance. With more than 7,000 professionals worldwide and a collective portfolio exceeding $18 billion in premium placed in 2024, our combined organization delivers a diverse trading platform for insurance carriers as well as expanded access and niche solutions for brokers and customers navigating complex and hard-to-place risks. The platform combines entrepreneurial culture with operational excellence to deliver tailored solutions and long-term value across the insurance ecosystem. For more information, please visit one80.com. If you have any questions about this posting, please contact one80careers@one80.com.

$64,800 - $80,000 Annual

das findest du bei uns

Wir gestalten die digitale Zukunft der Energiebranche.
Als europäische Digitalisierungsberatung treiben wir die Transformation im Energiesektor konsequent voran – mit dem Ziel, echte Wertschöpfung in allen Unternehmensbereichen zu entfalten. Unsere Mission: Die Energiebranche fit für die Zukunft machen – effizienter, nachhaltiger und digitaler.
Was uns auszeichnet? Neben spannenden und anspruchsvollen Projekten bieten wir Dir viel unternehmerische Freiheit, Raum für eigene Ideen und kontinuierliches persönliches Wachstum. Unsere Unternehmenskultur lebt von einem starken Miteinander, geprägt durch gegenseitige Wertschätzung, Vertrauen und Unterstützung.
Wir fördern individuelle Karrierewege und bieten exzellente Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – ganz ohne starre Hierarchien. Unsere Mitarbeitenden stehen im Mittelpunkt: Deshalb sind überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und zahlreiche Zusatzleistungen für uns selbstverständlich.

Unsere Aufgaben konzentrieren sich auf Transformationsprojekte im Energiesektor:

  • Definition und Umsetzung von IT-, Cloud- und KI-Strategien
  • Durchführung von Prozessanalysen und Identifikation digitaler Potenziale
  • Entwicklung von Governance-Strukturen und strategischen Transformationskonzepten
  • Verantwortung für Digitalisierungsvorhaben entlang der gesamten energiewirtschaftlichen Wertschöpfungskette – von Erzeugung über Transmission und Distribution bis hin zu Vertrieb und Kundenservice
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Lösungsansätzen, Target Operating Models sowie Programmsteuerung und Projektmanagement
  • Begleitung von Projekten über alle Phasen hinweg – von der Strategieentwicklung bis zur Implementierung
  • Aufbau und Einführung von Managementinstrumenten sowie IT/OT-Convergence-Lösungen, z. B. Smart Grids
  • Analyse und Optimierung von Organisationsstrukturen, Geschäftsprozessen und IT-Architekturen
  • Unterstützung bei der Pitchvorbereitung und Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Kundenlösungen

das bist du

Du bist analytisch, kommunikativ und neugierig. Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bringst eine hohe Eigeninitiative sowie eine unternehmerische „Can-Do“-Mentalität mit. Darüber hinaus zeichnen Dich folgende Eigenschaften aus:

  • 5-7 Jahre Beratungserfahrung, darunter auch in der Beratung imEnergiesektor
  • Praktische Erfahrung bei einem Energieversorger oder in branchenrelevanten Projekten
  • Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, sowie energienahen Fächern oder einem relevanten Studium im Bereich der Naturwissenschaften(z.B. Energiewirtschaft, Erneuerbare Energien, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Physik)
  • Affinität zu Themen wie Digitalisierung und Informationstechnologie
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der gängigen Consulting Methoden und Werkzeuge
  • Innovationsfreude und die Bereitschaft Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Strategisches Mindset und sehr gutes Verständnis der Geschäftsprozesse im Energiesektor
  • Freude bei derUmsetzung der Energiewende
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch (C1), Englisch verhandlungssicher
  • Reisebereitschaft
Zusätzlich von Vorteil:
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Metering, IT/OT Konvergenzsowie bei der Auswahl und Implementierung von relevanten Plattformen (ServiceNow, Salesforce, Jira)
  • Erfahrung bei der Definition und Umsetzung von IT-, Cloud- und KI-Strategien
  • ErfahrungmitProjektmanagement-Methoden (PRINCE2, Agile, Six Sigma) und IT Service Management (ITSM)
  • KI-Skills und erste Erfahrungenbei dem Aufbau und Umsetzung von KI-Initiativen

das sind wir

Wir glauben an eine offene und geradlinige Kommunikation, die von einem starken Teamgeist getragen wird. Grundwerte wie Kundenorientierung, Engagement im Job, Vertrauen und Integrität werden vorausgesetzt. Unsere Projekte sind oft international und erfordern Reisen. raw.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our product team. This role is to lead a product portfolio that shapes how lawyers practice law and makes legal services more accessible.This role is available to candidates across the United States or Canada (excluding Quebec) in a remote capacity. If you are local to one of our hubs (Burnaby, Calgary, or Toronto) you will be expected to be in office minimum two days per week for our Anchor Days.

What your team does

At Clio, we are building the future of legal practice, and that requires a deep, visceral understanding of the legal profession. As a former lawyer or legal professional, your firsthand experience with the day-to-day workflows, pain points, and administrative burdens of legal work isn't just a "nice-to-have"—it's an essential qualification. Your unique insights will directly inform our product strategy, ensuring we build solutions that truly resonate with and empower our customers.

You will join the Product team to lead a product portfolio that shapes how lawyers practice law and makes legal services more accessible. This role is focused on Clio's core case management product, a foundational part of our platform. Your lived experience will be critical as we dramatically improve usability, drive automation, and simplify attorney workflow with AI-powered tools.

What You'll Work On

  • Own a Core Product: Take accountability for a product portfolio with a direct impact on how legal work is practiced and delivered. You'll lead the strategy and roadmap for our core case management experience, a mission-critical component of our platform.

  • Transform User Experiences: You'll simplify legacy, form-heavy, and multi-tab experiences into efficient, intuitive workspaces. You have a passion for eliminating friction and creating "step-function improvements" that users love.

  • Drive AI-Powered Innovation: Use your legal domain expertise to envision how AI-driven automation can radically simplify attorney workflows and create meaningful efficiency gains.

  • Champion Product-Led Growth: You will lead with intuitive onboarding and automation solutions to make getting started and managing cases "dramatically easier," thereby driving user adoption and business growth.

  • Strategic & Data-Driven Execution: Synthesize business requirements and collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering to design and deliver high-impact features. Your decisions will be guided by a balanced mix of data and customer research, and you will be relentless in measuring the impact of your work.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Ship and launch features end-to-end, collaborating with cross-functional teams like Development, Product Design, Marketing, Sales, and Support

What You Bring

  • Prior Legal Experience: A background as a practicing lawyer, paralegal, or in a legal operations role is a significant asset. You should have a clear understanding of legal document standards, discovery processes, and litigation workflows.

  • Product Management Acumen: At least 6 years of product management experience in a SaaS or B2B software environment. This includes a proven track record of owning and shipping mission-critical products at scale.

  • Execution and Ownership: You are an outcomes-obsessed leader with a proven ability to make things happen, owning products throughout their lifecycle.

  • Strategic & Data-Driven Thinking: You are a visionary who uses both qualitative and quantitative data to drive product strategy, defining requirements and measuring impact. You are comfortable with ambiguity and have a strong track record of making decisions under uncertainty.

  • Collaboration: You are a natural collaborator who builds strong partnerships with Product, Design, and Engineering to deliver high-impact features that users love.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI-driven automation and machine learning concepts.

  • Prior experience selecting, implementing, or managing legal technology solutions (e.g., practice management software, e-discovery platforms) within a legal environment.

  • Experience in a non-traditional legal role, such as legal ops, legal tech consulting, or in-house innovation.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

  • Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance

  • Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.

  • Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.

  • $2000 annual counseling benefit

  • RRSP matching and RESP contribution

  • Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range* for this role is $137,500 to $161,800 to $186,100 CAD. There are a separate set of salary bands for other regions based on local currency.

*Our salary bands are designed to reflect the range of skills and experience needed for the position and to allow room for growth at Clio. For experienced individuals, we typically hire at or around the midpoint of the band. The top portion of the salary band is reserved for employees who demonstrate sustained high performance and impact at Clio. Those who are new to the role may join below the midpoint and develop their skills over time. The final offer amount for this role will be dependent on geographical region, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @clio.com email addresses.

Rockstar is recruiting for a nonpartisan nonprofit organization that leverages technology to equip the next generation of Americans with the skills to bridge divides. The client primarily works with college campuses, offering a comprehensive, evidence-based suite of products and services for stakeholders at every level—from college presidents to incoming students. Since launching in 2017, the organization has partnered with hundreds of campuses across the country. The organization was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation. This is a pivotal moment to join the team, as the organization is growing rapidly and advances in AI are creating new possibilities for how technology can help people engage in better dialogue across differences. In this role, the selected candidate will be at the forefront of shaping how these tools are leveraged to expand reach and impact.

About the Role

As the software product leader, this individual will report to the Co-Founder and Executive Director. The selected candidate will own the technical vision, strategy, and execution for the e-learning platform, and will be responsible for developing a product roadmap, ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and accessible. While the initial focus will be the flagship e-learning platform, Perspectives, the product leader will also drive technical innovation across the full suite of offerings, using emerging technologies (including AI) to expand impact, efficiency, and scale.

This individual will serve as a player-coach: managing one product team member (a Product Specialist), while partnering closely with an external development agency to deliver high-quality releases on time and on budget.

Responsibilities

Technical Product Leadership & Strategy

  • Serve as the Executive Director’s technical thought partner, shaping how and what is built in alignment with the overall product strategy.
  • Stay current on trends and emerging technologies in EdTech, AI, and related fields to inform product strategy and innovation.
  • Lead the technical strategy to ensure scalability, stability, security, accessibility, and responsible AI integration across all products.
  • Translate product priorities into a clear, actionable technical roadmap.

- Set and track product OKRs and KPIs.

Product Health & Scalability

  • Own system monitoring, data pipeline integrity, and risk tracking to safeguard product performance and stability.
  • Prototype, validate, and deliver AI-powered features and new AI-driven products that advance the organization’s mission.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and accessibility standards.

Team & Vendor Management

  • Manage a Product Specialist, fostering professional growth and high performance.
  • Lead relationships with all tech vendors — including development agency, platform hosting providers, and accessibility/security partners.
  • Manage the technical product budget, negotiate vendor contracts, and ensure high performance from all technical partners.
  • Maintain effective agile rituals for a hybrid internal/agency model, in partnership with the Product Specialist.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Collaborate with Education and Implementation teams to ensure products support effective content delivery and meet partner and user needs.
  • Work with Partnerships (Sales) to fulfill technical contract requirements, including integrations and security/privacy documentation.
  • Partner with Operations on privacy, security, and AI guardrails.
  • Ensure cross-functional alignment on product development, launches, and feedback loops.

Job Requirements

About You

  • 7+ years of B2B SaaS product management experience, including 3+ years leading or mentoring other product team members.
  • Experience in EdTech or a related field, with knowledge of data privacy/security and accessibility requirements; higher ed compliance experience preferred.
  • Proven success delivering products on a modular platform or third-party LMS.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-driven products; LLM experience strongly preferred.
  • Skilled in product discovery and learning methods, including A/B testing, user research, and analytics.
  • Track record of successfully managing budgets, vendor contracts, and delivery schedules.
  • Strong communicator, able to translate technical complexity for executives, developers, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Deeply aligned with the organization’s mission and excited to help bridge divides and promote constructive dialogue.
  • Experience in startup or scaleup environments, comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous contexts.

Benefits

- Compensation — $155,000-$170,000

  • A Mission-Driven Culture — the organization practices what it preaches, so the work culture is characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness
  • Remote-First — the organization was founded as a remote-first organization, and works hard to maintain a strong team culture across vast distances
  • Unlimited PTO — as well as 13 company holidays
  • Other Benefits — employer-supported health, vision and dental plans, subsidized parental leave, 3% 401k match, short- and long-term disability insurance, life and AD&D insurance, $1,000 annual professional development budget.

raw.description:
About the role:

We are currently hiring Creative Strategists to manage the creative production process for our portfolio of brands at BM Digital. As a Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for managing the entire video production and iteration process end-to-end, from concept to scriptwriting to live testing on TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and Google Ads.

Creative Strategists are the storytellers behind each video ad. This person is creative and analytical: they must be able to communicate a clear message through short form video and determine the best ways to vary content for different audiences. They will utilize both video and written language to craft compelling stories out of raw footage. They work alongside content creators and video editors but should have a demonstrated proficiency with visual communication and pacing.

About us:

BM Digital is a tech-enabled growth firm helping leading brands scale profitably and predictably. We combine full-service performance marketing with proprietary tech, including:

  • A creator marketplace managing over 80,000 influencer partnerships monthly
  • An AI-powered platform to streamline discovery, outreach, and whitelisting
  • Proven playbooks in influencer marketing, paid media, performance creative, and CRO

We’re trusted by 100+ high-growth DTC brands across beauty, wellness, lifestyle, and health. Our team of 70+ growth operators, analysts, and creatives manages over $200M in annual media spend and drives meaningful bottom-line impact for our partners.

BM Digital is not just an agency. We’re a scalable growth platform with a strong performance guarantee, a track record of results, and a culture built for A-players.

Responsibilities:

You will create performance ads that convert to client revenue growth by:

  • Utilizing data, research, and creative insights to formulate effective creative strategy
  • Analyzing data in platforms like Atria, Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager
  • Performing consumer, product, and competitor research using basic tools/resources
  • Collaborating with Post-Production, Production, and your Creative Strategy Lead to produce videos
  • Writing scripts and copy for video, static image ads, email campaigns.
  • Ensuring visuals match creative strategy outlined for the ad
  • Giving feedback that aligns to the creative strategy of the ad
  • Executing on feedback given by your Creative Strategy Lead
  • Analyzing the results of creative tests and utilizing this analysis to iterate
  • With oversight from your Creative Strategy Lead, responsible for weekly strategic account planning
  • Identifying top-performing concepts within accounts using data and creative analysis
  • Identifying effective concepts/trends in the social media ecosystem

Required Skills And Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Paid social or Direct Response experience (work/writing samples are a big plus)
  • Able to learn from training/examples and quickly execute new skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, draw actionable insights, and make data-driven decisions
  • Strong project management skills, with the capacity to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities
  • Strong understanding of social media (frequent user of at least one of these platforms: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook)
  • Experience with FB Ads Manager, and/or experience with other ad platforms including TikTok, Youtube, Snapchat
  • Able to work comfortably across Google Suite (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides)
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven work environment and adapt to evolving industry trends and best practices

Additional details:

  • This is a full-time, remote position
  • The annual compensation range is $120K-$280K USD which includes base, performance bonus and equity.

raw.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Regional IT Support Developer – MES Focus

We are looking for a Regional IT Support Developer with MES focus to join our dynamic European IT team and support our MES4.0 ecosystem source code level across the region.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people from different countries and cultures, has strong application development and troubleshooting skills, and is eager to deepen their knowledge of Jabil MES systems. The role is ideal for a technical professional who likes solving complex application issues, analyzing code-level problems, improving system stability, and contributing to regional digital transformation initiatives.

The position includes providing L3 code-level application support in rotation with other regional colleagues to ensure 24/7 support coverage for business-critical MES applications.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide L3 code-level support for MES application(s), and some other critical regional applications.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application issues, including code, database, interface, and integration-related problems.
  • Participate in a regional support rotation with other colleagues to provide 7x24 hour coverage for critical MES application support.
  • Active participation in Major Incident calls for troubleshooting and fixing the issues
  • Participate on the follow up Problem Management calls and provide feedback for efficient preventive actions identification
  • Build local environment for bug fixing and testing the corrections
  • Analyze incidents, identify root causes, and implement sustainable technical solutions.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain application components using technologies such as Angular, .NET, .NET Core, C#, SQL, and RabbitMQ.
  • Support MES ecosystem integrations with other business and manufacturing systems.
  • Work closely with Site SMEs, Digital Factory teams, IT Support teams, infrastructure teams, Devops and DBA colleagues and other regional/global counterparts.
  • Participate in regional and cross-functional IT projects, providing technical expertise and development support.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledgebase articles.
  • Propose and implement continuous improvements to increase application reliability, performance, supportability, and user experience.
  • Support application testing, deployment validation, and post-release stabilization activities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in application development and/or application support.
  • Strong technical experience with the following technology stack:
    • Angular, Typescript
    • .NET, .NET Core
    • C#
    • SQL
    • RabbitMQ
    • Rest APIs
    • Azure Devops , git
    • EKS, Docker
    • aws services
  • Proven experience in troubleshooting complex application issues.
  • Ability to analyze logs, code, database queries, interfaces, and application behavior to identify root causes.
  • Experience supporting business-critical applications in a production environment.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle, release management, and incident/problem management processes.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with multicultural teams across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Willingness to participate in regional 24/7 support rotation.
  • Willingness to travel regionally if required.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a strong developer mindset and enjoys solving technical problems.
  • Takes ownership of incidents, tasks, and technical improvements.
  • Is confident working with code, databases, integrations, and application logs.
  • Can remain calm and structured during critical production issues.
  • Asks questions, challenges assumptions, and learns from mistakes.
  • Is proactive, self-driven, and eager to continuously improve.
  • Thrives in a collaborative, multicultural environment.
  • Has a continuous improvement mindset with an Agile and Lean attitude.
  • Understands the importance of stable manufacturing systems and fast issue resolution.

Plus, but Not a Must

  • Experience with Jabil MES systems and the MES4.0 ecosystem.
  • Experience with Mendix.
  • Understanding of manufacturing, shopfloor, and business processes.
  • Experience with application monitoring, logging, and performance analysis.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or source control tools.
  • Experience working in a regional or global IT support organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in application development, application support, or a similar technical role.
  • Experience in a manufacturing environment is preferred.
  • Experience with MES or production-critical applications is a strong advantage.

Опис вакансії
Регіональний IT Support Developer – фокус MES

Ми шукаємо регіонального IT Support Developer з фокусом на MES, який приєднається до нашої динамічної європейської IT-команди та підтримуватиме вихідний код екосистеми MES4.0 по всьому регіону.

Це чудова можливість для людини, яка любить працювати з колегами з різних країн і культур, має сильні навички розробки та усунення технічних проблем, а також хоче поглибити знання систем MES Jabil. Роль ідеально підходить для технічного спеціаліста, який отримує задоволення від вирішення складних проблем застосунків, аналізу проблем на рівні коду, покращення стабільності систем і участі в ініціативах цифрової трансформації регіону.

Посада передбачає надання L3 підтримки на рівні коду у ротації з іншими регіональними колегами, щоб забезпечити цілодобову (24/7) підтримку критично важливих MES-застосунків для бізнесу.

Ваші обов’язки

  • Надавати L3 підтримку на рівні коду для MES-застосунків та інших критично важливих регіональних систем.
  • Усувати складні проблеми застосунків, включно з кодом, базами даних, інтерфейсами та інтеграціями.
  • Брати участь у регіональній ротації підтримки разом із колегами для забезпечення 24/7 підтримки критичних MES-застосунків.
  • Активно брати участь у дзвінках щодо Major Incident для вирішення інцидентів.
  • Брати участь у подальших дзвінках Problem Management та надавати фідбек для визначення ефективних превентивних дій.
  • Створювати локальне середовище для виправлення багів і тестування виправлень.
  • Аналізувати інциденти, визначати першопричини та впроваджувати стійкі технічні рішення.
  • Розробляти, покращувати та підтримувати компоненти застосунків із використанням технологій Angular, .NET, .NET Core, C#, SQL, RabbitMQ.
  • Підтримувати інтеграції MES-екосистеми з іншими бізнес- та виробничими системами.
  • Тісно співпрацювати з локальними SME, Digital Factory командами, IT підтримкою, інфраструктурними командами, DevOps та DBA, а також регіональними і глобальними колегами.
  • Брати участь у регіональних та міжфункціональних IT-проєктах, надаючи технічну експертизу та підтримку розробки.
  • Створювати та підтримувати технічну документацію, інструкції з усунення несправностей та базу знань.
  • Пропонувати та впроваджувати покращення для підвищення надійності, продуктивності, зручності підтримки та користувацького досвіду.
  • Підтримувати тестування застосунків, валідацію релізів та стабілізацію після релізів.

Що ми шукаємо

  • Мінімум 4 роки практичного досвіду в розробці застосунків та/або їх підтримці.
  • Сильний технічний досвід зі стеком технологій:
    • Angular, TypeScript
    • .NET, .NET Core
    • C#
    • SQL
    • RabbitMQ
    • REST API
    • Azure DevOps, Git
    • EKS, Docker
    • AWS сервіси
  • Досвід усунення складних технічних проблем.
  • Уміння аналізувати логи, код, SQL-запити, інтерфейси та поведінку систем для визначення першопричин.
  • Досвід підтримки критично важливих бізнес-застосунків у продакшн-середовищі.
  • Розуміння життєвого циклу розробки ПЗ, реліз-менеджменту та процесів інцидент- і проблем-менеджменту.
  • Добрі комунікаційні навички англійською мовою (усно та письмово).
  • Здатність працювати з мультикультурними командами в різних країнах і часових поясах.
  • Готовність брати участь у регіональній 24/7 ротації підтримки.
  • Готовність до регіональних відряджень за потреби.

Ідеальний кандидат

  • Має сильне мислення розробника та любить вирішувати технічні задачі.
  • Бере відповідальність за інциденти, задачі та технічні покращення.
  • Впевнено працює з кодом, базами даних, інтеграціями та логами.
  • Зберігає спокій і структурованість під час критичних інцидентів у продакшені.
  • Ставить запитання, ставить під сумнів припущення та навчається на помилках.
  • Проактивний, самостійний і прагне постійного вдосконалення.
  • Добре працює в команді та мультикультурному середовищі.
  • Має mindset безперервного покращення (Agile та Lean підхід).
  • Розуміє важливість стабільності виробничих систем і швидкого вирішення проблем.

Плюсом, але не обов’язково

  • Досвід роботи з системами Jabil MES та екосистемою MES4.0.
  • Досвід роботи з Mendix.
  • Розуміння виробничих процесів (shopfloor) та бізнес-процесів.
  • Досвід моніторингу застосунків, логування та аналізу продуктивності.
  • Знання DevOps практик, CI/CD або інструментів контролю версій.
  • Досвід роботи в регіональній або глобальній IT-підтримці.

Кваліфікації

  • Бакалавр у сфері інформаційних технологій, інженерії, комп’ютерних наук, бізнес-інформатики або суміжних спеціальностей.
  • Мінімум 4 роки досвіду в розробці застосунків, їх підтримці або подібній технічній ролі.
  • Досвід у виробничому середовищі є перевагою.
  • Досвід з MES або критичними виробничими системами є сильним плюсом.

Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Werde ein Teil unseres Teams aus dem Home-Office (remote), in Wetzlar, in Berlin, in München oder in Villingen-Schwenningen. Hilf uns, mit deinem Wissen und deiner Erfahrung das volle Potenzial unserer Kunden zu erschließen. Lass dich von den spannenden Einblicken in den verschiedensten Projekten inspirieren und wachse gemeinsam mit uns und unseren Kunden!

deine aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für die Definition der Gesamtlösung basierend auf Kundenanforderungen in einem Projekt nach innen und nach außen
  • Leitung des Anforderungs- und Lösungsdefinitionsprozesses
  • Beratung unserer Kunden zur Anpassung und Optimierung ihrer Prozesse

  • Technische Validierung von Lösungen
  • Identifikation, Benennung und Mitigation von technischen Risiken
  • Erstellen und Dokumentieren des Lösungsdesign und aller dafür relevanten Artefakte
  • Konzeption wesentlicher Lösungskomponenten

  • Ansprechpartner:in/Coach/Expert:in für das Umsetzungsteam bei Fragen zur Struktur der Gesamtlösung

dein profil

das erwartet dich bei dia

Zusätzlich fördern wir deine Weiterbildung und unterstützen dich bei Fach-Zertifizierungen – dafür stehen dir 10 Tage (80 Stunden) pro Jahr zur Verfügung.

Werde ein Teil unseres Teams aus dem Home-Office (remote), in Wetzlar, in Berlin, in München oder in Villingen-Schwenningen. Lass dich von den spannenden Einblicken in den verschiedensten Projekten inspirieren und wachse gemeinsam mit uns und unseren Kunden! raw.excerpt: About DaCodesAt DaCodes, we build high-impact software solutions for startups and global companies across LATAM and the U.
raw.description:
About DaCodes

At DaCodes, we build high-impact software solutions for startups and global companies across LATAM and the U.S. We work with senior engineers who take ownership of their work, care about production quality, and thrive in collaborative, fast-moving environments.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with a strong focus on integrations and distributed systems, capable of designing, implementing, and maintaining robust, scalable, and secure backend systems using Node.js and NestJS.

This is not a configuration or low-code role. You will be embedded in a senior engineering team, working directly with a U.S.-based client in English on a daily basis. We expect deep understanding of backend engineering — protocols, concurrency, security, and real production systems.

Why this role is interesting

  • Work on complex backend systems with real-world integrations (SaaS platforms, payment APIs, ERPs)
  • Solve challenges around scalability, reliability, and distributed systems
  • Collaborate with a highly senior team with strong technical ownership
  • Work directly with U.S.-based engineering teams — in English, daily

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable backend services using Node.js + NestJS
  • Develop and maintain robust, secure REST APIs and internal services
  • Work on integrations between SaaS platforms, payment/notification services, and internal systems
  • Implement event-driven flows (webhooks, retries, idempotency)
  • Contribute to authentication and authorization flows (OAuth2, JWT, API keys)
  • Identify and solve performance, concurrency, and scalability challenges
  • Improve observability, logging, and error handling in production
  • Own technical decisions and contribute to architecture discussions

Requirements

  • 4+ years developing backend systems in production environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js + NestJS in production
  • Experience building and consuming APIs (REST, webhooks, third-party integrations)
  • Experience integrating with external SaaS platforms or services (payment, notifications, data pipelines, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT or similar)
  • Strong grasp of backend fundamentals: performance, scalability, reliability, error handling
  • Advanced English — you will work directly with U.S.-based teams and clients on a daily basis

Nice to Have

  • Experience with iPaaS tools (Workato, Mulesoft, Boomi, or similar)
  • Experience integrating with ERPs (NetSuite, SAP, Business Central)
  • Experience with high-concurrency or high-throughput systems
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • CI/CD practices and DevOps awareness

How We Work

Project Manager / Scrum Master

Role Overview

A Project Manager / Scrum Master at Argano is a professional responsible for leading and managing medium to complex (enterprise-level) projects using the Agile Scrum methodology. This role requires a deep understanding of project management principles, Scrum practices, and a proven track record of successful project delivery. They play a crucial role in ensuring project teams are organized, efficient, and deliver high-quality products for our clients on time. They are responsible for planning, executing, and closing projects through Agile Methodology while ensuring that they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget. They work closely with stakeholders, team members, and senior management to ensure project success.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Project Manager/Scrum Master for one or more Agile development teams, ensuring they follow Agile principles and practices.
  • Lead and manage either one or multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and on budget.
  • Define project scope, goals, and deliverables based on the SOW (Statement of Work). Create a detailed project plan, including timelines, resource allocation, and key dependencies.
  • Maintain and manage a Project Budget Tracker/Burn Sheet to ensure allocated budget is not exceeded.
  • Assemble project teams, assign tasks, and manage resources. Foster collaboration and communication among team members.
  • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies. Monitor and manage risks throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Maintain clear and regular communication with stakeholders, providing updates on project progress, challenges, and achievements.
  • Ensure that project deliverables meet the required quality standards. Implement quality control processes.
  • Prepare and present project status reports to senior management and stakeholders. Highlight key milestones, issues, and risks.

Minimum and/or Preferred Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • MBA or relevant master's degree, advanced degree preferred.

Experience

  • 5 to 10 years' experience in project management.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience as a Scrum Master and/or Agile Project Manager
  • Proven experience managing complex projects with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in software development, IT, or technology-related projects is preferred.
  • Experience with project risk assessment and mitigation strategies.
  • Experience in conducting quality reviews and implementing corrective actions.
  • Project management software knowledge such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana, Trello, etc.
  • Previous experience in IT industries and with ERP and/or CRM technology platforms.

Skill Requirements

  • Project Management Skills: Proficiency in project management methodologies and best practices.
  • Scrum Master Skills: In-depth understanding of Agile and Scrum principles.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Strong ability to communicate project progress and issues to stakeholders.
  • Strong Project Leadership skills: Provide guidance and support to ensure successful project execution.
  • Stakeholder Management: Skill in managing stakeholder expectations and addressing their needs.
  • Project Management Tools: Familiarity with project management tools and software, such as JIRA, Trello, or Microsoft Project.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and client expectations, while directing QA Lead.
  • Conflict Resolution: Resolve conflicts and disputes within project teams or with stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving: Address project issues and challenges with innovative solutions.
  • Escalation Management: Manage proper internal communication to Argano leadership team and stakeholders, ensuring appropriate internal and external escalation processes are followed.

Job Description

The Senior Manager, Geospatial Analytics – Localized Assortment & Store Clustering leads the development of localized, store-specific recommendations by combining geospatial intelligence, shopper behavior, and store-level performance data. This role uses Placer.ai and other integrated data sources to understand who shops in a store, who lives within its trade area, and how local market dynamics should shape assortment, clustering, and planning decisions.

This leader translates complex market, mobility, demographic, and operational data into actionable recommendations that help drive category growth and incremental sales at both the enterprise and store level. The role serves as the subject matter expert on store clustering and localized opportunity identification, advising customer teams, retail partners, and internal stakeholders on where and how to tailor category strategies to local demand.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain store-level clustering strategies based on shopper behavior, trade area composition, demographic shifts, and emerging market trends.
  • Leverage Placer.ai and other data sources to create micro-assortment recommendations informed by who shops a store and who lives within its store polygon or market area.
  • Analyze store-level and market-level data to identify current and future localized opportunities that influence category strategy and assortment decisions.
  • Build event-, weather-, and season-based playbooks that help customer teams and partners respond to changing local demand patterns.
  • Identify local and regional seasonal opportunities, including multicultural events, temporary population shifts, and other market-specific drivers of demand.
  • Detect emerging local whitespace opportunities, such as changes in retirement communities, proximity to college campuses, and evolving neighborhood dynamics.
  • Conduct incursion analysis to evaluate the impact of new store openings near existing locations and recommend actions to mitigate risk or unlock growth.
  • Use trip circuit and trip mission insights to better understand shopper intent and inform localized assortment and category recommendations.
  • Synthesize data from the Category Intelligence Platform, including GIS datasets, point-of-sale data, inventory, weather, and real-o-grams, into clear business insights and recommendations.
  • Serve as the go-to expert on store clustering methodology and geospatial analytics for customer teams, retail partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Present actionable, data-driven recommendations that support both strategic planning and local execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Analytics, Business, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Significant experience in geospatial analytics, retail analytics, category management, localized assortment, space planning, or related commercial strategy roles.
  • Experience using Placer.ai or similar mobility/location intelligence platforms.
  • Strong understanding of trade area analytics, shopper behavior, store clustering, and localized retail strategy.
  • Demonstrated experience working with integrated datasets that connect geospatial, shopper, and store-level operational data.
  • Proven ability to convert complex analyses into clear business recommendations that influence customer-facing and internal decisions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate as a subject matter expert across multiple audiences.

description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

raw.title: Chaplain (Part-Time) - Louisville, KY
raw.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Part-Time, Louisville, KY

~20 hours a month

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.
